meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 让你在不改动 GitHub 的前提下盘点仓库:拉取所有 open 的 issue 和 PR,每个条目开一个后台分析任务,把带永久链接证据的报告写到 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录。全程只读,不发评论、不合 PR、不关单、不打标签。
howto.when: 当你提到“triage”、“github triage”等触发词,或要求排查仓库里的 issue/PR 时接管。一条条目对应一个后台任务。

say.text: 帮我 triage 一下这个仓库的 open issues
say.note: 每个 issue 生成一份带证据链接的报告

say.text: triage PRs,看看哪些可以合并
say.note: 每个 PR 出一份合并就绪度报告

say.text: github triage:先看 bug 类的 issue
say.note: 先按类型分类,再逐条分析

howto.what_en: Read-only GitHub triage: fetches every open issue and PR, spawns one background task per item, and writes reports with GitHub permalinks to /tmp/{datetime}/. Never comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "github triage" and similar keywords, or ask to review open issues/PRs. One item equals one background task; nothing is written to GitHub.

say_en.text: Triage the open issues in this repo
say_en.note: Each issue gets a report with permalink evidence

say_en.text: Triage the open PRs and check merge readiness
Github triage: start with the bug-type issues
say_en.note: Items are classified, then analyzed one by one
